data.instructions: Read the text. Choose the correct answer.
data.text: On Monday I fell while I was skating and broke my arm. At the hospital they took an X-ray — I saw a photo of my own bones! The nurse, Miss Elena, was the kindest person there. On Wednesday the whole team visited me: Ingrid brought a huge card, Maya brought a science comic, and Diego interviewed the doctor for his news show. Kili sat on my window every morning. On Sunday I went home with a blue cast on my arm — and fourteen signatures on it!

data.script: Oliver: The first night I was a bit afraid, but the nurse told me funny stories. … Oliver: Every morning Kili sat on my window with a small flower in his beak. … Oliver: The food wasn't bad — the jelly was green and it danced! … Oliver: I wrote a new song in the hospital. It's called Broken Arm Blues. … Oliver: The doctor said I was very brave when they took the X-ray. … Oliver: And when I went home, the team was waiting with a banner that said WELCOME BACK!
